title: Known-ball size coordinate
statement: For every counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the register vector of $\sigma$ has value $\sigma.\mathrm{cp}$ at coordinate $9$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the value of the register vector
associated with $\sigma$ at coordinate $9$ is the known-ball size $\mathrm{cp}$ of
$\sigma$.
